key_concepts: Reproduction ensures continued existence of organisms

Testes produce sperm cells and testosterone while the scrotum protects and regulates tempe

The female reproductive system includes ovaries, fallopian tubes, uterus, and vagina

Fallopian tubes connect the ovaries to the uterus
The uterus holds and nourishes a fertilized egg until the baby develops
